scripts.build: npm run native:build && npm run plugin:build
scripts.check: npm run chrome:check && npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run check && streamdeck validate ./dev.local.media-controls.sdPlugin && streamdeck pack ./dev.local.media-controls.sdPlugin
scripts.chrome:check: node --check chrome-extension/background.js && node --check chrome-extension/page-main.js && node --check chrome-extension/bridge-isolated.js && node --check chrome-extension/options.js && node --check dev.local.media-controls.sdPlugin/ui/settings.js
scripts.test:native: cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/media-info/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/media-keys/Cargo.toml
